headword: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}

definitions.explanation: The long-term increase in Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gas emissions. A major topic in news and environmental discussions.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Sea levels are rising due to the effects of global warming.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}い{止|と}める→食い止める：06384_kuitomeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{二酸化|にさんか}{炭素|たんそ}→二酸化炭素：04630_nisankatanso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{排出量|はいしゅつりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To stop global warming, we need to reduce carbon dioxide emissions.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard term in news, environmental science, and policy discussions. Frequently appears in newspaper articles and school textbooks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (global warming progresses)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (effects of global warming)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent global warming)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (global warming countermeasures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧: climate change — broader term encompassing all types of climate shifts, not just warming
- ⟦{温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}→温室効果：17354_onshitsukouka⟧: greenhouse effect — the mechanism behind warming, not the warming itself
